report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is unsupported. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and DB spans returning 200/ok. Metrics show order v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 has no traffic. Deployment record shows only baseline v1.0.0 with no prior version, so no faulty deployment is evidenced. No bounded cause can be established from current telemetry.
missing_evidence: Checkout error logs or error-rate metrics showing actual failures to confirm the incident exists
Gateway traces (excluded) to localize where checkout errors originate
Order service logs (excluded) to inspect error details
Deployment history showing any version change preceding the incident window
Latency/error baselines to distinguish normal from degraded behavior
